nodes.name: Connecteam Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Connecteam Forms webhook (form_submission). Pinned fictional pre-start, safety and job-completion submissions included.

nodes.name: Verify Secret & Normalize Event
nodes.notes: x-webhook-secret (constant time) or optional HMAC mode · configured forms only · dedupe by formSubmissionId · answers, media and submitter normalised.

nodes.name: Fetch Form Definition
nodes.notes: Connecteam Forms API · scope forms.read · form name + question titles (not in the webhook payload).

nodes.name: Fetch Submitter
nodes.notes: Connecteam Users API · display name only (first name + last initial).

nodes.name: Build Checklist Record
nodes.notes: Question titles · pass/issues/safety evaluation · job number, address, phone keys · HTML note · deal search bodies.

nodes.name: Search Deals by Job Number
nodes.notes: Scope crm.objects.deals.read · job number property EQ · pipeline + matchable stages.

nodes.name: Search Deals by Site Address
nodes.notes: CONTAINS_TOKEN on the street name; scored in code (street number must match).

nodes.name: Resolve Deal Match
nodes.notes: job 100 · address 50+40×similarity · contact 60 · +10 per corroborating source · ambiguity margin.

nodes.name: Stage Advancement Router
nodes.notes: Note always · stage → Ready for Invoicing only for a passed, new job-completion submission from an allowed stage (forward-only).

nodes.name: Create Checklist Note
nodes.notes: Scope crm.objects.contacts.write (notes) · note→deal association 214 · never auto-retried.

nodes.name: Build Ops Alert
nodes.notes: Slack only for unmatched/ambiguous, safety issues, incomplete completions, write failures.

nodes.name: Audit Logger
nodes.notes: IDs, statuses and counts only · stdout + static-data ring buffer.

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when this workflow is selected as its own Error Workflow.

parameters.content:
## n8n-connecteam-field-checklist-hubspot-deal-updater
Connecteam field checklists → HubSpot deal note → Ready for Invoicing. dhRobin Systems.

**Safe defaults:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true`, `DRY_RUN=true`. No Connecteam, HubSpot or Slack calls until both are `false`.

**Stage 1** Execute *Connecteam Webhook Trigger* (10 fictional deliveries).
**Stage 2** `SANDBOX_MODE=false`: real lookups, writes simulated.
**Stage 3** `DRY_RUN=false`: notes, stage changes and Slack alerts go live.

Connecteam sends a shared secret header, not an HMAC. See README.md.

### Deal matching
Job number → site address → customer phone. Ambiguous or unmatched submissions write nothing and raise an alert.

### Sanitized error path
No stack traces, headers, answers or request bodies. Keys, tokens and webhook secrets are redacted.
